title: mcpforge/v1 — kind: Consumer
description: Field for field with the worked example at 02 §11.2. The consumer record is a git artefact BECAUSE it is a grant — compiled like a role, approved like a role. Every call needs BOTH a registered consumer and a resolved human identity; authorization is the INTERSECTION, never the union (CLAUDE.md #6). Dynamic Client Registration does not exist.

id.description: Immutable, like a tool id — audit rows and consumption edges reference it. Renaming is a retire-and-register pair, both recorded (CLAUDE.md §5).

owner.description: Accountable team; a named human is required at review.

expiresAt.description: Registrations EXPIRE. Renewal is a re-approval, not a no-op (02 §11.2).

ref.description: A REFERENCE. Never a value. Ever. A credential.ref that is not a secretRef:// URI is rejected (02 §11.5, CLAUDE.md #8).

boundIssuers.description: Which identity issuers this consumer may present user tokens from.

publicKeys.description: GATEWAY-SIDE verification material for method: private-key-jwt (05 §A.4). PUBLIC and git-committed. Note the asymmetry: credential.ref names the consumer's PRIVATE key and the gateway resolves it never; verification is against these. additionalProperties:false rejects an OKP JWK's private component 'd', so a private key pasted here fails validation outright.

then.$comment: 05 §A.5: for private-key-jwt the record must carry at least one publicKeys[] entry, or the gateway has nothing to verify against and the registration can never authenticate.

bindingTypes.description: The Phase 5 gate (02 §11.4). ConsumerAuthorized can only NARROW tools/list.

writeAllowed.description: Independent of, and intersected with, the human's role.

roles.description: May act only within these roles even if the human holds more.

operatingWindow.description: Optional; absent = 24/7 with a stated reason (02 §11.2).

networkOrigins.description: Optional CIDR or mTLS SAN pin.

humanInTheLoop.description: Has teeth: false forces humanApprovalRequired: true on every write this consumer attempts, regardless of the tool's own setting (02 §11.2).

bindingGrants.description: Optional on the consumer as well as the role (02 §11.4).
